sentence: [This site's November birthstone page](/november-birthstone/) tracks a similar gap on a different month, where citrine joined topaz forty years after that 1912 original, in the same 1952 batch that brought in alexandrite.

[January's popularly claimed Capricorn stone turns out, in Kunz's actual table, to belong to Aquarius instead](/january-birthstone/), and [the Virgo stone in that same table is carnelian, not the sapphire](/september-birthstone/) most shopping sites repeat.
